description: Pre-publish QA and GitHub Pages deployment for portfolio web projects. Triggers: GitHub Pages, deploy, publish, go live, portfolio site, branch protection, OG tags, social preview, pre-launch checklist, making a repo public, or the user's GitHub (zeevmala). Covers the Pages deploy workflow, SEO/OG, a11y, performance budget, deploy anti-patterns.

results.query: the bus-stop map project is finished and i want it live on github pages tonight. single index.html plus a data folder. walk me through it and tell me what i should check first
going public with this repo tomorrow — can you do a full pre-publish pass? console errors, dead links, leftover placeholder text, whatever else i'd normally miss
pasted my project link into a whatsapp group and it showed no preview card at all, just the bare url. the og tags are in the head as far as i can tell
this repo is about to get two collaborators. set up branch protection on main — reviews required, status checks required, and i dont want anyone bypassing it including me
i'm making an old private repo public. what do i need to scrub or check before i flip that switch — there was a .env in there early on
before this goes in my portfolio i want it to actually pass an accessibility check and work properly on a phone. contrast, keyboard nav, touch targets, the sidebar behaviour at 375px
deployed to pages and the map loads but all the geojson requests 404. locally it works. im fetching /data/stops.geojson
my project needs a build step now (vite) so serving from the branch root doesn't work anymore. i need an actions workflow that builds and publishes to pages
need a decent social preview image for the repo — what size, where does it go, and how do i point the meta tags at it once its on pages
can you review this repo the way a hiring manager would look at it before i put the link on my cv? readme, demo link, screenshot, the lot
im rendering about 80,000 points and the map is unusable. at what count should i stop using geojson directly and move to vector tiles
hebrew text in my leaflet popups renders right to left but the numbers inside the same line jump to the wrong position. how do i control the bidi there
joining 2M gps points to 5k polygons in geopandas is crawling. both layers are in the same projected crs and i've already tried chunking it
my segmentation model looks great on validation and terrible on a new area. i think the random chip split is leaking. how should i split spatially instead
look at api/routers/parcels.py and tell me if the structure is sane — response models, error handling, whether the pagination approach holds up at scale
i need to get this fastapi backend deployed somewhere cheap with a postgres attached. railway or fly.io, and what does the dockerfile need to look like
set up a github actions workflow that runs pytest and ruff on every pull request against main, python 3.12, with pip caching
my python package is ready to publish to pypi. whats the current recommended flow — pyproject.toml, build, twine? and how do i test it first
deploying a next.js app to vercel for the first time. it has server actions and an api route hitting supabase. what do i need to configure
zustand or redux toolkit for a react app with about six slices of shared state? one of them updates very frequently
